items.name: breakdown
items.prompt: This is a geography YouTube Short used as a topic reference. 1) Give the full verbatim transcript of the narration with timestamps (mm:ss.s) per sentence. 2) State the topic in one sentence, every place/country/region/route/number/date it mentions, and every factual claim made. 3) Any channel name, watermark, handle or on-screen title visible. 4) A timestamped visual log: what is on screen (map type, satellite, 3D, flags, characters, text), what moves, every cut and transition, on-screen text exactly as shown, sound effects and music. 5) The hook in the first 3 seconds: words + visual. 6) The story structure (setup, question, payoff, ending/loop) and the CTA. 7) Total duration and average seconds between visual changes.
